_note:
composition_reference_update, now that a READER for reference_id exists.

D-A-REQUIRED-ID-NO-TOOL-CAN-SUPPLY: reference_id was required by exactly one tool and mentioned by NO tool in the catalogue, so the tool was unsatisfiable by construction and no declaration could fix it — the reader had to be BUILT. composition_reference_list ships in this cycle and is declared as the emitter.

WHY A NEW FILE RATHER THAN AN EDIT TO scenarios-c-ref3.json. That scenario's falsifier is written for the broken world — 'the model invents a reference_id (there are none to find, so any id is fabricated)' — and with a reader present that premise is false. It is left exactly as it is. (Noted while reading it: that parenthetical already contradicted its own seed, which inserts one reference.)

THE SEED IS COPIED VERBATIM, so the two scenarios differ only in what is asked of the result.

scenarios.prompt: Please fix reference title for 'Tidal Almanac {run_word}' — it should read 'Tidal Almanac, Revised'.
scenarios.prompt_source: Verbatim from scenarios-c-ref3.json, which took it from meta.synonyms['fix reference title'] + ['update reference metadata']. Unchanged on purpose: the question is whether the PLATFORM moved, so the prompt must not.

sql.statement: INSERT INTO reference_source (id, created_by, project_id, book_id, title, author, source_url, content, embedding_model, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '019d5e3c-7cc5-7e6a-8b27-1344e148bf7c', (SELECT project_id FROM composition_work WHERE book_id='{book_id}' LIMIT 1), '{book_id}', 'Tidal Almanac {run_word}', 'M. Solene', 'https://example.invalid/tidal', 'Notes on the Obsidian Trench tides.', 'none', now())
sql.why: A reference to EDIT. Copied verbatim from scenarios-c-ref3.json. reference_source still has no MCP create path — this cycle built the READER, not a writer — so the seed inserts directly, the way translation's fixture does.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM reference_source WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: The reference must exist before the prompt can name it.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the model passes a reference_id that is NOT the seeded row's id — with a reader present, a wrong id is now a fabrication rather than a forced guess; OR it reports the title as changed while the card is still unclicked (approve is null, so the store MUST be unchanged and any claim of success is a narrated write); OR it reaches the confirm card without ever calling composition_reference_list, which would mean it got the id from somewhere this scenario cannot account for. CONTROL: the tool being REFUSED once for reference_id before the model lists is expected and is not a failure — that refusal is what names the reader.

ship_audit.absent_case: covered by scenarios-c-ref3.json, which runs the same prompt against a shelf the model cannot read.
